Efficiency and Energy Savings with Advanced Techniques

Our BS-III Servo Series employs advanced techniques to meet high-efficiency and energy-saving demands. With a multi-pump control system and real-time production adjustments through CAN BUS, it can efficiently produce small and large plastic parts. This results in lower energy consumption and higher productivity, offering a cost-effective solution tailored to customer requirements.

Accredited as National First Grade Energy Saving, these machines operate at just 60% of the first-grade consumption level. Compared to traditional hydraulic systems, BS-III Servo Series can save between 20% to 80% of energy. The servo motor delivers hydraulic oil precisely as needed, preventing unnecessary heating and temperature rise while conserving water.
Experience efficiency and energy savings with BS-III Servo Series.

heading: Borche BM Series IMM
title: Borche BM Series IMM | HTS International
description: Borche multi-component machines are your gateway to stable, precise, and flexible solutions tailored to diverse custom requirements.

blocks.text: Borche multi-component machines are your gateway to stable, precise, and flexible solutions tailored to diverse custom requirements. Drawing from over a decade of expertise in this category, Borche has achieved the remarkable feat of 5K injection in a single machine.

Our range of multi-component machines covers various configurations, including parallel, L shape, vertical, piggy-back, and more. These options ensure we meet the unique demands of your projects with precision and efficiency.
MT Series
Introducing MT Series: Your Path to Dual-Component Excellence

Experience innovation with our newly-developed MT Series, featuring a broader platen and parallel injection units. Within the MT Series, you have the freedom to select two injection units that best suit your specific needs.
MV Series
MV Two-Component Machine: Elevate with Vertical Injection

Experience innovation with our MV two-component machine, meticulously designed with a vertical injection structure. The injection unit is strategically mounted vertically on top of the fixed platen, ensuring that the machine covers the same footprint as a standard machine.
ML Series
BM-ML Two Component Machine: Where Precision Meets Adaptability

Our BM-ML two-component machine is an upgraded version built upon the BS standard injection machine. Let's take the BM150-022ML, for instance. This machine boasts main and side injection units equipped with 40 and 25 screws, respectively.

Notably, the mould thickness has been increased from 500mm to 550mm while retaining the clamping specification of the BS150-III. This design provides enhanced adaptability to meet a range of customer requirements, allowing for different injection unit sizes to be configured as needed.
MK Series
Precision Redefined with Close-Nozzle Configuration
Explore Precision Moulding: Reducing the gap between two nozzles optimises space among four tie bars, creating a more compact mould design.
Independent control of two injection units allows distinct injection sequences, enhancing overall moulding precision to meet the highest standards.
3C Series
Customised Solutions with Our Three or More Component Machines

Our three or more component machines are tailored to the unique needs of our valued customers. If you're interested in exploring the options and capabilities of this machine, we invite you to reach out to us for more information.

heading: Automatic Tool Quick Changers
title: Automatic Tool Quick Changers | HTS International
description: In the world of EOAT (end of arm tooling) applications, the robot automatic tool changer shines as a true ally.

blocks.text: In the world of EOAT (end of arm tooling) applications, the robot automatic tool changer shines as a true ally. This ingenious system empowers industrial robots with the capability to seamlessly switch EOAT tools during any application cycle.
Commonly positioned between the tool and the transport device (tray, robot), this changer system comes to the rescue when switching becomes essential. Some even refer to it as robot end effectors.

One side of the robot can be equipped with multiple tool sides, making it remarkably cost-effective and enabling tool changes within mere seconds. Moreover, its quick changer system boasts a sleek, compact design that's both rust-resistant and durable.

Our range covers payloads from 3kg to 300kg, featuring main models like QCA05, QCA15, QCA35, QCA50, QCA100, and QCA200. With user-friendly plug-and-play ease, lightweight design, high repeatability, and the assurance of 1 million safe cycles, this system is a game-changer.

For in-depth specifications, peruse our catalog. And should you seek custom tool changer designs, feel free to reach out. CRG possesses the research and development prowess to craft ideal solutions for your industrial automation needs.

blocks.text: The WSQB Vertical Mixer is the ideal solution for processors requiring rapid and consistent blending of plastic granules and masterbatch. Engineered for high productivity and low energy consumption, this machine ensures a perfectly uniform mix every time.

Safety First
We prioritize operator security. The WSQB series is equipped with a Safety Interlock Switch that prevents the machine from operating unless the lid is fully closed and secured.

The WSVL Linear Vibrating Screen is an essential component for any high-quality plastic processing line. Designed to automatically remove impurities and oversized particles, it ensures that only perfectly sized material reaches your production machinery, protecting your equipment and the quality of your final product.
Key Features
Automated Material Filtering: Seamlessly integrated into your production flow to automatically screen out unwanted materials and dust, ensuring a high-purity feed.
Durable Stainless-Steel Build: Constructed entirely from high-grade stainless steel to prevent rust and contamination, making it ideal for long-term use in industrial environments.
Low-Maintenance Engineering: Designed with simplicity in mind, the WSVL requires minimal upkeep, allowing your team to focus on production rather than repairs.
Rapid Cleaning & Screen Changes: The intuitive design allows for quick access to the screen, making cleaning and material changeovers fast and effortless.
Customisable Mesh Sizes: We offer a variety of screen meshes that can be customised to your specific material requirements for precision grading.

The VPM Series Volumetric Mixer is designed for precision dosing of masterbatch and additives directly into the material stream. With a focus on accuracy and versatility, this system ensures that your colour and property additives are distributed perfectly, reducing waste and ensuring batch-to-batch consistency.
Key Features
Universal Material Compatibility: Equipped with a high-precision dosing screw designed to handle a wide range of materials, from standard masterbatch to specialised additives.

Specialised Mixing Tube: Our unique tube design creates a highly efficient mixing chamber, ensuring that additives are thoroughly blended with the base material before reaching the processing machine.
Consistent Ratios: Engineered to maintain strict volumetric accuracy, helping you avoid over-dosing and significantly lowering your material costs.
Easy Integration: Designed to be mounted directly onto injection moulding machines or extruders for immediate "at-the-throat" mixing.

The VGF Series Gravimetric Feeder is the ultimate solution for manufacturers who demand absolute dosing accuracy. By utilising high-sensitivity load cells and advanced weight-tracking software, the VGF ensures your additive ratios remain perfect, regardless of changes in material density or flow.
Core Advantages

Ultra-Precise Stepper Motor: Driven by a high-torque stepper motor to ensure consistent, reliable feeding. The system offers a lightning-fast response time to real-time weight fluctuations, maintaining your exact set points.
Intuitive Touchscreen Control: Features a user-friendly, high-resolution touchscreen interface. Set your dosing percentages, monitor material consumption, and adjust parameters on the fly with ease.

Loss-in-Weight Technology: Unlike standard mixers, the VGF constantly calculates the weight of the material being fed, automatically compensating for any inconsistencies to prevent costly over-dosing.
Seamless Factory Integration: Designed for quick installation and easy cleaning, making it the perfect "plug-and-play" addition for injection moulding or extrusion lines.

The VCM Series Volumetric Doser is engineered for manufacturers who require consistent additive feeding with high torque. By combining advanced servo technology with a robust gear reduction system, the VCM delivers unbeatable dosing stability even when handling dense or difficult materials.
Performance Highlights

Advanced Servo Motor Technology: Unlike standard motors, our adopted servo system provides ultra-precise speed control and consistent rotation, ensuring your dosing ratios remain perfect throughout the entire production run.

High-Torque 1:5 Gear Reducer: Equipped with a specialised 1:5 ratio gear reducer. This provides the mechanical advantage needed to handle higher material loads and prevents motor overloading during heavy-duty operation.
Stable & Reliable Performance: The combination of electronic precision and mechanical strength makes the VCM ideal for high-pressure environments where "set-and-forget" reliability is essential.
Compact & Modular Design: Easily integrates with your existing injection moulding or extrusion equipment, allowing for rapid installation and minimal downtime.

The WVGM Series is a high-performance gravimetric blending solution designed for complex material recipes. Utilising advanced loss-in-weight technology and a sophisticated calculation engine, this blender ensures that every component—from base resin to additives—is measured with absolute surgical precision.
Core Features & Benefits

High-Precision Calculation Engine: The onboard controller utilises advanced mathematical modeling to provide ultra-precise measurements, ensuring recipe consistency even with varying material densities.
Intelligent Recipe Management: Streamline your production with a controller capable of saving up to 50 unique data sets. Switch between jobs instantly without manual recalibration.

Low-Maintenance Brushless Drive: Equipped with a high-torque brushless gear motor. This ensures silent operation and long-term reliability while eliminating the maintenance needs of traditional brushed motors.
Variable Screw Speed Control: Fine-tune your dosing with fully adjustable screw speeds, allowing for maximum flexibility across different material types and flow rates.
Rapid Material Changeover: Designed for high-mix environments, the system allows for quick and safe access to the mixing chamber, significantly reducing downtime during colour or material swaps.

The WVCM Series provides a high-precision solution for the volumetric dosing of masterbatch and additives. By combining a low-maintenance drive system with a sophisticated digital controller, the WVCM ensures your material ratios remain consistent, batch after batch.
Key Features & Advantages
Advanced Calculation Logic: The integrated controller is programmed with sophisticated calculation methods to ensure precise measurements and minimise material waste.
Intelligent Data Storage: Optimise your workflow by saving up to 50 unique sets of production data. This allows for near-instant setup during repeat jobs or material changeovers.

Brushless Gear Motor: Experience silent, reliable operation with our low-maintenance brushless drive. Designed for continuous industrial use, it eliminates the wear and tear associated with traditional brushed motors.
Precision Speed Control: The screw speed is fully adjustable via the digital interface, giving you granular control over the dosing flow to match your specific production requirements.
Rapid Access Design: Engineered for safety and speed, the "easy access" design allows operators to perform material changes and cleaning quickly, keeping downtime to a minimum.

The WSQA Series is engineered for speed and durability. Its horizontal design allows for aggressive, high-velocity mixing, making it the perfect solution for large batches of plastic granules and masterbatch. Built with industrial-grade materials, it is designed to handle the most demanding mixing schedules with ease.
Key Features & Advantages
Premium Stainless-Steel Construction

Both the mixing bucket and high-speed blades are manufactured from high-grade stainless steel. This prevents rust, eliminates material contamination, and ensures a long service life even with abrasive materials.
100° Tilting Discharge System
Unloading material is fast and effortless. The bucket is designed to tilt up to 100 degrees, ensuring complete discharge and making deep cleaning between colour changes remarkably simple.
Precision Mixing Timer
Achieve perfect consistency every time. The integrated control system allows operators to set specific mixing cycles anywhere from 0 to 30 minutes, ensuring repeatable results for every batch.
Chain-Drive Safety Protection
Safety is integrated into the core design. A specialised chain safety protection device is installed to safeguard both the operator and the mechanical components during high-speed operation.

The WSQF Series is a robust, automatic vertical stirrer designed for large-scale blending operations. Featuring a vertically mounted screw system, this machine is the industry standard for processors who need to mix high volumes of virgin material with masterbatches or regrind quickly and uniformly.
Key Features & Benefits

High-Speed Vertical Blending: The vertically mounted mixing screw ensures a rapid, bottom-to-top material flow, resulting in an perfectly even mix in a fraction of the time required by standard mixers.
Universal Material Compatibility: Engineered to handle all types of plastic materials, from delicate virgin resins to heavy colour masterbatches and recycled regrind.

Corrosion-Resistant Internals: Both the mixing barrel and the internal screws are constructed from high-grade stainless steel, ensuring zero contamination and a long service life in demanding environments.
Advanced Electrical Protection: Equipped with a comprehensive electrical control protection system to safeguard the motor and components against power surges or operational errors.
Optional Thermal Integration: For specialised applications requiring moisture removal or pre-heating, a heating function can be added to the WSQF upon request.

The WSQD Series is a versatile vertical mixer designed for manufacturers who require precision colour blending and moisture removal in a single step. By integrating a high-efficiency heating system with a vertical stirrer, the WSQD ensures your materials are perfectly mixed and optimally dried before they hit the production line.
Core Features
Precision Thermal Control: Equipped with an integrated temperature controller and digital timer, allowing operators to set exact drying heat and mixing durations for consistent batch results.
Double-Layered Thermal Insulation: The mixing barrel features advanced double-wall insulation, which maximises heat retention for energy efficiency and ensures the exterior remains safe to the touch.

Industrial Stainless-Steel Build: The entire mixing assembly and barrel are constructed from high-grade stainless steel, preventing rust and ensuring a contamination-free environment for sensitive resins.
Advanced Motor Protection: Built with a specialised overload protection system that automatically safeguards the motor during heavy-duty operation, extending the lifespan of the machine.

The WSPM Proportional Valve is a critical component for processors looking to maximise efficiency and reduce material costs. Designed to automatically blend virgin resin with regrind (secondary material) at precise ratios, this system ensures a steady, consistent flow of material to your injection moulding or extrusion machines.
Key Features & Benefits

Automated Ratio Mixing: Effortlessly mix virgin and secondary materials according to your specific production requirements. The WSPM streamlines the recycling process, ensuring regrind is fed back into the system without manual intervention.

Precision Microcomputer Control: Driven by an advanced microcomputer and a high-response electromagnetic valve. This combination ensures that measurements are consistently accurate and the material ratio remains stable throughout the run.

Meticulous Stainless-Steel Build: Constructed entirely from high-grade stainless steel for maximum durability. The interior is engineered to be completely free of "dead zones," ensuring a smooth, clog-free flow for all raw materials.

Seamless Process Integration: The compact, well-made design allows it to be easily installed into your existing vacuum loading or conveying system, providing an immediate upgrade to your material handling efficiency.

blocks.text: Grease Pump: Precision Lubrication for Optimal Performance

Our advanced Grease Pump is engineered to deliver a precise and timed quantity of grease to the rotating or frictional components of machine tools, plastic injection moulding machines, and more. This ensures consistent and reliable lubrication, enhancing the performance and longevity of your equipment.
Count on our Grease Pump for smooth and efficient operation, reducing the risk of wear and tear on critical machine parts.

Our Single Line oil supply system is designed for efficient and cost-effective lubrication. It consists of one drive pump and a main supply tube, with distributor tubes connecting to each oil supply point. This straightforward configuration results in affordable installation.
Key Features
Suitable for Various Applications: This system is primarily designed for medium and small oil supply systems and can be classified as manual or automatic, depending on the pump type.
Customisable Control: Users have the flexibility to monitor and control the oil supply system through various methods, allowing for tailored specifications that suit specific environments.

Versatile Application: This system is versatile and ideal for various applications, including large machine tools, steel manufacturing equipment, casters, rollers, injection machines, presses, printers, automated production lines, and more.
Experience simplified and reliable lubrication with our Single Line Oil Supply System.

Our Two Line Grease Supply System simplifies and enhances lubrication in medium to large industrial equipment. This system operates through two main oil supply tubes connected to a change-over valve. As grease is supplied through one main tube to all distributors, pressure within the tube increases. When the pressure reaches a preset level, the supply automatically switches to the other main tube through the change-over valve.
Key Features
Versatile Application: Ideal for medium to large oil supply systems, this system can accommodate over 1000 oil supply sites based on pump and distributor selection.
Pressure Control: The operating pressure is precisely controlled by a pump change-over valve, ensuring accurate and efficient lubrication.
Easy Maintenance: The design allows for straightforward maintenance and repairs.
Flexible Modification: Users can easily add or remove oil supply sites after installation and enable individual oil supply as needed.

This concentrated lubricating system is well-suited for various applications, including iron manufacturing equipment and heavy-load transportation machines. Ensure the smooth operation of your industrial equipment with our Two Line Grease Supply System.
High-Performance HCG Grease for Extreme Conditions
Our HCG grease, available in the HCG model, is a top-quality, universal grease suitable for the most demanding conditions. Here are its outstanding features:
Extreme Pressure Capability: HCG grease is engineered to excel even under extreme pressure and heavy-duty scenarios, making it ideal for challenging industrial applications.
Exceptional Abrasion Resistance: This grease boasts excellent abrasion resistance, ensuring the longevity of components even in high-friction environments.
Water Resistance: HCG grease is designed to repel water, providing reliable lubrication in damp or wet conditions.
Long-Lasting Lubrication: With its low-capacity lubricating effect, HCG grease ensures that critical components receive consistent lubrication over an extended period, reducing maintenance frequency.

blocks.text: Concentrated Lubricating Oil Supply Device
The Concentrated Lubricating Oil Supply Device is a comprehensive solution designed to efficiently drive and maintain all oil supply sites from a single device.

This device serves to increase the life expectancy of the entire system while also reducing operational and maintenance costs. It finds applications across a wide range of industrial machinery, including machine tools, textile machines, injection machines, presses, packaging machines, and other general industrial equipment.
Depending on usage methods, it can be categorized into fixed quantity oil supply and proportional oil supply types.
Key Features

All-in-One Solution: The device is capable of driving and maintaining all oil supply sites within your industrial machinery from a single, centralized unit. This simplifies maintenance and streamlines operations.

Cost-Efficiency: By using a Concentrated Lubricating Oil Supply Device, you can significantly reduce running and maintenance costs. This efficiency results in cost savings over the lifespan of your equipment.
Versatile Applications: This device is suitable for a wide range of industrial machines, making it a versatile solution for different sectors and applications.

Variable Oil Supply Types: The device is adaptable to specific requirements. It can be used in both fixed quantity and proportional oil supply scenarios, ensuring it aligns with the needs of your machinery.
Fixed Quantity Oil Supply System

The Fixed Quantity Oil Supply System is a reliable and precision-driven lubrication solution. This system utilises lubricating oil from the pump to operate pistons inside valves, delivering precise oil quantities ranging from 0.01 to 1.0 cubic centimeters per stroke (cc/st). The valves are designed to operate automatically based on the pump discharge pressure, making this system suitable for applications requiring oil supply to multiple points, even at considerable distances of up to 20 metres. In fact, it can accommodate up to 50 separate oil supply sites. This system is versatile and widely applicable, serving a broad spectrum of machinery, from small-scale equipment to large industrial machines.
Key Features
Precision Lubrication: The Fixed Quantity Oil Supply System excels at delivering precise amounts of lubricating oil to each lubrication point, ensuring optimal equipment performance.
Automation: Valves within the system are automatically operated in response to the pump's discharge pressure, making it a hands-free and efficient solution.
Extended Range: This system is capable of oil supply over extended distances of up to 20 metres, allowing it to cater to larger machinery and complex setups.
Multi-Point Lubrication: With the capacity to serve up to 50 separate oil supply sites, it can be applied to various industrial machines, both small and large.
Versatility: Its adaptability makes it a versatile solution suitable for a wide range of machinery across different industries.
The Fixed Quantity Oil Supply System is designed to provide consistent, precise, and automated lubrication, enhancing the performance and longevity of equipment in diverse applications.
The Proportional Oil Supply System is designed with essential features to optimise lubrication efficiency and adapt to various industrial requirements
Key Features

Efficient Flow Regulation: This system uses strategically designed pipes to introduce resistance to the flow of lubricating oil from the pump. This precise control of oil flow ensures an efficient and even distribution of lubrication to each oil supply site.

Proportional Oil Supply Valve: The system features a proportional oil supply valve that minimises oil discharge under low-pressure conditions. It offers the flexibility of continuous or intermittent oil supply, making it adaptable to diverse application needs.

Single Ø4mm Pipe Design: The Proportional Oil Supply System uses a single pipe with an external diameter of Ø4mm to connect the pump to each oil supply site. This design allows compatibility with a wide range of oil viscosities and simplifies installation.

Precision for Machine Tools: Ideal for precision machine tools and applications that require high-viscosity processing in compact spaces, this system ensures precise and consistent lubrication, promoting machinery reliability and longevity.

Versatile Application: Beyond precision tools, the system finds use in various industries, including die-casting machines, where its adaptability to different oil viscosities and efficient design make it a valuable choice.
